# Real VRChat client-log lines, 2026-10-02 to 2026-10-06, one block per client launch.
# Filtered to the lines roster.parse_line reads (player join/leave dropped); every usr_, avtr_,
# wrld_ id, player, avatar and room name and service id replaced, consistently across files.
# `## log <n>` starts a launch (a replay: the reader resets). `## <worn id> <label> <source> --
# <truth>` follows each local switch's settling Initialize line, where the bridge decides.
# <label> is calibration, reset, join, swap or unlabelled, never from any classifier; <source>
# is its ground truth: operator (labelled live), trackingtype (TrackingType 6->4 at the
# accept), upright-fast (first Upright tens of ms after the change: not held), upright-run
# (a slow first Upright in a calibration run, the weak kind), structural (a room transition
# or a different id), none. `## accepted` follows a labelled calibration's accept.
